in_sanskrit.name: Somnath
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The god of the moon, Som, is the presiding deity of the temple town Somnath in Gujarat, India.

in_marathi.name: Somnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Somnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord of the Moon, Lord of Prosperity, Lord of the Fortune, Lord of the Wealth
